project_overview.project_summary: This engineering design project centers on CAD Design Engineer for 3D Conversion. The initial brief says: Seeking a skilled CAD design engineer to convert measured parts from photos into STEP or Inventor 3D files, including manufacturing drawings. The ideal candidate will have experience in precision engineering and be able to accurately translate 2D measurements into 3D models. The work sits mainly in Architecture, CAD, and engineering documentation, Engineering & Architecture, 3D Modeling & CAD. Stable project themes include technical design, validation and review, production or approval documentation. The available evidence includes 90 conversation messages, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. For technical onboarding, the key task is to trace functional requirements into the editable design, review checks, physical or compatibility constraints, and production/approval outputs. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
